questions.question_text: The statement "Atithidevo bhava." is found in which reference?
options: Antakale dhamma lai javanu Swaminarayan Bhagwannu vardan chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Class 48, Taittiriya Upanishad - 1/11/2 states "Atithidevo bhava."

questions.question_text: Complete the statement from Taittiriya Upanishad - 1/11/2: "______ bhava."

questions.explanation: Bhaktichintamani - 68/9 states "Mārā janne antakāḷe, jarūr māre āvvu; Birud māru e na badle, te sarve janne jaṇāvvu."
